WITH month_series AS (
    SELECT generate_series(
        DATE_TRUNC('month', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'),  
        DATE_TRUNC('month', $__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'),    
        '1 month'::interval
    )::date AS month_date
),
monthly_readings AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', d.datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date AS month_date,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN d.is_override THEN d.reset_value
                ELSE d.daily_power
            END
        ) AS monthly_power
    FROM user_powermeterreadingdata d
    WHERE
        d.form_id = 709
        AND $__timeFilter(d.datetime)
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', d.datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date
)
SELECT
    ms.month_date::timestamp AS "time",
    COALESCE(mr.monthly_power, 0) AS "Monthly Power (kWh)"
FROM month_series ms
LEFT JOIN monthly_readings mr ON ms.month_date = mr.month_date
WHERE
    ms.month_date >= (DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST($__timeFrom() AS timestamptz) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'))::date
    AND ms.month_date <= (DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST($__timeTo() AS timestamptz) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'))::date
ORDER BY ms.month_date ASC;

WITH month_series AS (
    SELECT generate_series(
        DATE_TRUNC('month', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'),  
        DATE_TRUNC('month', $__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'),    
        '1 month'::interval
    )::date AS date
),
monthly_readings AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date AS date,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN is_override THEN reset_value
                ELSE daily_flow
            END
        ) AS monthly_flow
    FROM user_flowmeterreadingdata
    WHERE
        form_id = 724
        AND $__timeFilter(datetime)
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date
),
monthly_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        ms.date,
        CASE
            WHEN mr.monthly_flow IS NOT NULL AND mr.monthly_flow > 0 THEN mr.monthly_flow
            ELSE 0
        END AS monthly_consumption
    FROM month_series ms
    LEFT JOIN monthly_readings mr ON ms.date = mr.date
    WHERE
        ms.date >= (DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST($__timeFrom() AS timestamptz) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'))::date
        AND ms.date <= (DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST($__timeTo() AS timestamptz) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'))::date
)
SELECT
    date,
    SUM(monthly_consumption) AS "Inlet Flow Meter"
FROM monthly_consumption
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY date;

WITH month_series AS (
    SELECT generate_series(
        DATE_TRUNC('month', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'),  
        DATE_TRUNC('month', $__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'),    
        '1 month'::interval
    )::date AS month_date
),
monthly_inlet AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date AS month_date,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN is_override THEN reset_value
                ELSE daily_flow
            END
        ) AS monthly_inlet_flow
    FROM user_flowmeterreadingdata
    WHERE
        form_id = 724
        AND $__timeFilter(datetime)
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date
),
monthly_power AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date AS month_date,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN is_override THEN reset_value
                ELSE daily_power
            END
        ) AS monthly_power_val
    FROM user_powermeterreadingdata
    WHERE
        form_id = 709
        AND $__timeFilter(datetime)
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date
)
SELECT
    ms.month_date::timestamp AS "time",
    (mp.monthly_power_val / NULLIF(mi.monthly_inlet_flow, 0)) AS "Monthly Power Intensity (kWh/m³)"
FROM month_series ms
LEFT JOIN monthly_inlet mi ON ms.month_date = mi.month_date
LEFT JOIN monthly_power mp ON ms.month_date = mp.month_date
WHERE
    ms.month_date >= (DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST($__timeFrom() AS timestamptz) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'))::date
    AND ms.month_date <= (DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST($__timeTo() AS timestamptz) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'))::date
ORDER BY ms.month_date ASC;

WITH month_series AS (
    SELECT generate_series(
        DATE_TRUNC('month', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'),  
        DATE_TRUNC('month', $__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'),    
        '1 month'::interval
    )::date AS month_date
),
monthly_permeate AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date AS month_date,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN reset_value IS NOT NULL AND reset_value != 0 THEN reset_value
                ELSE daily_flow
            END
        ) AS total_permeate
    FROM user_flowmeterreadingdata
    WHERE
        form_id = 726
        AND $__timeFilter(datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date
),
monthly_feed AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date AS month_date,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN reset_value IS NOT NULL AND reset_value != 0 THEN reset_value
                ELSE daily_flow
            END
        ) AS total_feed
    FROM user_flowmeterreadingdata
    WHERE
        form_id = 733
        AND $__timeFilter(datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date
)
SELECT
    ms.month_date::timestamp AS "time",
    (mp.total_permeate / NULLIF(mf.total_feed, 0)) * 100.0 AS "Monthly % Recovery"
FROM month_series ms
LEFT JOIN monthly_permeate mp ON ms.month_date = mp.month_date
LEFT JOIN monthly_feed mf ON ms.month_date = mf.month_date
WHERE
    ms.month_date >= (DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST($__timeFrom() AS timestamptz) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'))::date
    AND ms.month_date <= (DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST($__timeTo() AS timestamptz) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'))::date
ORDER BY ms.month_date ASC;

WITH month_series AS (
    SELECT generate_series(
        DATE_TRUNC('month', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'),  
        DATE_TRUNC('month', $__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'),    
        '1 month'::interval
    )::date AS month_date
),
monthly_chem AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', c.date::timestamp)::date AS month_date,
        m.chemical_name,
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.consumption > 0 THEN c.consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption
    FROM user_chemicalstocktrackerdata c
    JOIN user_chemicalmasterdata m
      ON LOWER(c.chemical_name) = LOWER(m.chemical_name)
     AND m.team_id = 396
     AND m.is_active = true
    WHERE
        c.form_id = 741
        AND $__timeFilter(c.date::timestamp)
    GROUP BY
        DATE_TRUNC('month', c.date::timestamp)::date,
        m.chemical_name
)
SELECT
    ms.month_date::timestamp AS "time",
    COALESCE(mc.consumption, 0) AS "value",
    mc.chemical_name AS "metric"
FROM month_series ms
JOIN monthly_chem mc ON ms.month_date = mc.month_date
WHERE
    ms.month_date >= (DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST($__timeFrom() AS timestamptz) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'))::date
    AND ms.month_date <= (DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST($__timeTo() AS timestamptz) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'))::date
ORDER BY
    ms.month_date ASC,
    mc.chemical_name ASC;

monthly_sludge AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', s.date::timestamp)::date AS month_date,
        SUM(CASE WHEN s.daily_sludge_cake > 0 THEN s.daily_sludge_cake ELSE 0 END) AS monthly_sludge_total
    FROM user_sludgecaketrackerdata s
    WHERE
        s.form_id = 742
        AND $__timeFilter(s.date::timestamp)
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', s.date::timestamp)::date
)
SELECT
    ms.month_date::timestamp AS "time",
    COALESCE(msl.monthly_sludge_total, 0) AS "Monthly Sludge Cake (Tons)"
FROM month_series ms
LEFT JOIN monthly_sludge msl ON ms.month_date = msl.month_date
WHERE
    ms.month_date >= (DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST($__timeFrom() AS timestamptz) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'))::date
    AND ms.month_date <= (DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST($__timeTo() AS timestamptz) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'))::date
ORDER BY ms.month_date ASC;
